t: Titan TTB811DRH electric concrete breaker is a powerful 230V demolition hammer engineered for demanding site work and renovation projects. The heavy-duty tool features a robust 1700W motor, delivering 50J of impact energy at 1600bpm to efficiently break concrete slabs, foundations, and masonry. An anti-vibration system and soft-grip handle enhance user comfort, and the adjustable auxiliary handle provides improved control. A durable all-metal gearbox and fan-cooled motor ensure lasting performance, making it a reliable professional tool for challenging tasks. Supplied with chisels and a carry case.
